title: Six questions that change the design

hotspots.label: Access and keys
hotspots.detail: Read-only keys are preferred, where supported, for content, permission, and activity data.

hotspots.label: Identity
hotspots.detail: Do users in the source system match users in the SSO system associated with Glean?

hotspots.label: Environments
hotspots.detail: Is there a dev, test, or sandbox environment to build and validate the connector against?

hotspots.label: Click-through
hotspots.detail: Where should users go when they click a document in Glean? That is the viewURL.

hotspots.label: Stability and change
hotspots.detail: Will the API URL stay static? How often are permissions updated in the source?

hotspots.label: No API
hotspots.detail: Can the source export content to an external storage location? That is the fallback when no usable API exists.
